rebuttals.putForth: A Silicon Valley rich guy playing champion of the working man.

rebuttals.text: Ro Khanna is a cable-news congressman: all hits, no bills.
Nobody outside Twitter knows who Ro Khanna is.
Ro Khanna's platform is built for the primary, not the general.
Ro Khanna has no executive record.
Ro Khanna has never faced an electorate bigger than a House district.
Ro Khanna's progressivism stops where his donors' portfolios begin.
